_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management of adverse event reports, encompassing data collection, formatting, organization, processing, analysis, and communication.

receivers._description: Captures details of recipients and their types/organizations involved in receiving adverse event safety reports.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: receiver_receivertype
columns.description: Stores the repeated receiver type ID (6) for multiple receivers in the database.

columns.name: receiver_receiverorganization
columns.description: Stores abbreviated names of up to 10 characters for organizations receiving adverse event reports, frequently being the FDA.

senders._description: Records adverse event report senders, including their type and organization.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: sender_sendertype
columns.description: Stores the type of sender (likely 2 represents a manufacturer or distributor).

columns.name: sender_senderorganization
columns.description: Stores the organization name for the sender, typically FDA-Public Use.

_meta.definition: The unifying capability across all tables is the management of data related to adverse events associated with pharmaceuticals.

drug_brand_names._description: Records brand names associated with specific drugs and safety reports in adverse event cases.

columns.name: drug_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in drug_brand_names

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: brand_name
columns.description: Stores up to 255 characters of brand names for various pharmaceutical products.

drug_openfda._description: Tracks adverse event reports for various drugs, including their identifiers, generic names, pharmacological classes, product types, and routes of administration.

columns.name: drug_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in drug_openfda

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: application_number
columns.description: Stores unique identification numbers for New Drug Applications (NDA) and Abbreviated New Drug Applications (ANDA).

columns.name: generic_name
columns.description: Stores the names of generic drugs in a text format.

columns.name: pharm_class_cs
columns.description: Stores pharmaceutical class names for drugs, such as Nitrofurans, Fluoroquinolones, Estradiol Congeners.

columns.name: pharm_class_epc
columns.description: Stores pharmaceutical class names for drugs, often followed by EPC (Electronic Access to Adverse Event Reporting System) codes.

columns.name: product_type
columns.description: Stores type of human prescription drugs in this database.

columns.name: route
columns.description: Stores the method of drug administration, such as oral or intravenous.

drug_substances._description: Tracks specific drug components associated with adverse event reports in FDA database.

columns.name: drug_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in drug_substances

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: substance_name
columns.description: Stores up to 255 characters of drug substance names, such as DAPAGLIFLOZIN PROPANEDIOL, METFORMIN HYDROCHLORIDE, etc.

drugs._description: Tracks detailed information on various drugs, their characteristics, dosages, and usage in adverse event reports.

columns.name: drug_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in drugs

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: drugcharacterization
columns.description: Stores numerical codes representing drug characterizations such as small molecule (1) or biologic (2).

columns.name: medicinalproduct
columns.description: Stores brand names of pharmaceutical products, such as XIGDUO XR, METHOTREXATE, NITROFURANTOIN, CIPROFLOXACIN, and NIRAPARIB.

columns.name: drugbatchnumb
columns.description: Stores unique batch numbers for drugs, as demonstrated by repeated occurrence of D592967C and D656783E.

columns.name: drugauthorizationnumb
columns.description: Stores unique identification numbers for authorized drugs.

columns.name: drugdosagetext
columns.description: Stores text descriptions of drug dosages, including form (e.g., 2 X 500 MG / DAY, INTRAVAGINAL) and sometimes unknown values.

columns.name: drugdosageform
columns.description: Stores various dosage forms of drugs, such as Tablets, Solutions for injection in pre-filled pens.
samples: Solution for injection in pre-filled pen

columns.name: drugstartdate
columns.description: Stores the starting date of drug administration in YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: drugenddate
columns.description: Stores the date (YYYYMMDD format) when a drug event ended or was reported to end.

columns.name: drugindication
columns.description: Stores indications for which drugs are used, such as diabetes mellitus, rheumatic disorder, urinary tract infection, and ovarian cancer metastatic.

columns.name: actiondrug
columns.description: Stores integer values indicating the role of a drug as an active (1), control (4), or both (5) agent in adverse event reports.

columns.name: drugadditional
columns.description: Stores additional drug identifiers (1, 3, or 2) for multiple drugs in the database.

columns.name: drugadministrationroute
columns.description: Stores the method of drug administration (e.g., 048: oral, 065: injection, 067: topical) for each drug record.

_meta.definition: The process of formatting, organizing, and maintaining adverse event data using a standard format.

seriousness._description: Records adverse event seriousness levels associated with individual safety reports.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: seriousnessdeath
columns.description: Stores an integer indicating the number of reported deaths associated with a serious adverse event.

columns.name: seriousnesslifethreatening
columns.description: Indicates the degree of potential for death due to an adverse event.

columns.name: seriousnesshospitalization
columns.description: Stores an integer value indicating the degree of hospitalization associated with a serious adverse event.

columns.name: seriousnessdisabling
columns.description: Stores an integer value indicating the degree to which the adverse event resulted in temporary or permanent disabilities.

columns.name: seriousnesscongenitalanomali
columns.description: Stores an integer value indicating the presence of congenital anomalies associated with a serious adverse event.

columns.name: seriousnessother
columns.description: Stores an integer value indicating the level of seriousness for adverse events, where 1 represents non-serious and 2 represents serious.

_meta.definition: A system for managing and organizing adverse event data collected from various sources, including reporting, formatting, processing, analysis, and storage.

report_duplicates._description: Tracks reported adverse events where duplicates have been identified across different safety reports and potential sources.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: duplicate_safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the duplicate_safetyreport entity

columns.name: duplicate_source
columns.description: Stores the origin of duplicate reports, such as MC Brazil, BFARM, CADRBFARM, LSMI, SANOFI.

_meta.definition: This domain unifies the tables that organize and manage adverse event data for patients, including patient demographics, onset age, weight, sex, and death date.

patients._description: Captures patient demographic and outcome data associated with adverse event safety reports.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: patientonsetage
columns.description: Stores the age at which patients experienced adverse events (e.g., 75, 8, 44, etc.)

columns.name: patientonsetageunit
columns.description: Stores patient age units in integer format, possibly years.

columns.name: patientagegroup
columns.description: Stores patient age groups, all represented as integers (6, 5) in this dataset.

columns.name: patientweight
columns.description: Stores patient weights in kilograms, including decimal places.

columns.name: patientsex
columns.description: Stores gender of patients (1=male, 2=female) based on sample values.

columns.name: patientdeath_date
columns.description: Stores the textual representation of the date when a patient passed away (if available).

_meta.definition: The process of formatting and organizing adverse event data using a standard format, including primary sources and reports

primary_sources._description: Captures details of the original sources and their qualifications for adverse event reports, along with the reporter's country.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: primarysource_qualification
columns.description: Stores the qualification level of primary sources (1-5), where higher numbers indicate more reliable data.

columns.name: primarysource_reportercountry
columns.description: Stores the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the reporter's country from primary sources.

reports._description: Captures details of adverse event reports submitted to the FDA by various sources.

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: safetyreportversion
columns.description: Stores the version number of safety reports, consistently set to 1 in these samples.

columns.name: receivedate
columns.description: Stores date of report reception as a 4-digit year and 6-digit day (YYYYMMDD format).

columns.name: receivedateformat
columns.description: Stores the repeated format value for the date received of adverse event reports.

columns.name: transmissiondate
columns.description: Stores the date of report transmission as a 4-digit year and 6-digit day (YYYYMMDD) format.

columns.name: transmissiondateformat
columns.description: Stores a repeated integer value representing a specific date format used for report transmissions.

columns.name: receiptdate
columns.description: Stores adverse event report receipt dates as 4-digit year and 6-digit day (YYYYMMDD) format.

columns.name: receiptdateformat
columns.description: Stores the repeated format code for receipt dates in reports.

columns.name: reporttype
columns.description: Stores the type of adverse event report, as all samples indicate a single report type.

columns.name: serious
columns.description: The "serious" column indicates the severity level (1 for serious, 2 for non-serious) of adverse events reported.

columns.name: primarysourcecountry
columns.description: Stores the 10-character ISO country code of the primary source for adverse event reports.

columns.name: occurcountry
columns.description: Stores the 10-character country code for locations where adverse events occurred.

columns.name: companynumb
columns.description: Stores unique identifiers for pharmaceutical companies associated with adverse event reports.

columns.name: duplicate
columns.description: The "duplicate" column indicates identical reports within the database.

columns.name: fulfillexpeditecriteria
columns.description: Indicates whether a report meets expedited criteria for FDA review (1 - yes, 2 - no).

_meta.definition: The process of managing and analyzing adverse event data associated with pharmaceuticals

reactions._description: Records adverse events and their associated reactions reported in FDA safety reports.

columns.name: reaction_id
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in reactions

columns.name: safetyreportid
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the safetyreport entity

columns.name: reactionmeddrapt
columns.description: Stores adverse event reactions as per MedDRA PT classification, including Arthropathy, Diabetes mellitus, Intervertebral disc protrusion, Weight decreased, and Off label use.

columns.name: reactionmeddraversionpt
columns.description: Stores the version number of the Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) associated with each reaction.

columns.name: reactionoutcome
columns.description: Stores the final outcome of adverse reactions, where 1 indicates death and 6 indicates recovery or recovery pending.
